response.text:
Here are the deadlines and dated items for October 2026, soonest first.

**Deadlines**
- Return the overdue library items to Stadtbibliothek Musterstadt by Fri 2 Oct 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. The record says to post or send by Mon 28 Sep 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. Fees keep rising until then.
- Objection to the Muster BKK contribution notice (optional) is due Wed 14 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. An objection does not suspend payment.
- Cancel the residence permit appointment if you can't attend it by Mon 19 Oct 2026 [item:itm_jr5r71kc1r78].
- The objection (Einspruch) deadline for the Finanzamt Musterstadt assessment is Wed 21 Oct 2026 [item:itm_mtehckcf6q7a]. After that date the assessment becomes final.
- The FunkNetz Smart M mobile contract must be cancelled so the cancellation arrives by Wed 14 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2]. The post-by date is Thu 8 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].

**Payments**
- Parking warning fee, due Fri 2 Oct 2026: 30.00 € [item:itm_31yxpwg03cdb]. The amount was read from a scan, so please check it against the paper letter.
- Monthly rent to Wohnbau Musterstadt eG, due Mon 5 Oct 2026: 640.00 € [item:itm_b1b5643x7qy7].
- Additional operating costs, due Fri 9 Oct 2026: 184.30 € [item:itm_dmaw27qvv18n].
- Extension fee, due Wed 14 Oct 2026: 100.00 € [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m]. Pay it by girocard at the appointment.
- Electricity advance to Stadtwerke, due Thu 15 Oct 2026: 48.00 € [item:itm_kttk9625293w]. It is collected by direct debit.
- Health and care insurance contribution, due Thu 15 Oct 2026: 156.55 € [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe]. It is collected by direct debit.

**Appointments**
- Dental check-up, Thu 8 Oct 2026 at 09:15 [item:itm_tt8cexs1k1tw].
- Residence permit extension at the Ausländerbehörde, Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp]. Bring all the listed original documents.

For objections, please consider getting advice if you're unsure.
